tools.name: search_sets
tools.description: Find sets by name or number, theme IDs, budget, pieces, age recommendation or retirement status. Use price_basis delivered for budgets including shipping; item preserves the original item-only search. Delivered search excludes unknown shipping before pagination. Returns links to Brickfact comparison

tools.name: get_set_details
tools.description: Look up a set's specifications, retirement information and monitored offers. Future retirement dates are estimates. Reported shipping totals and unverified stock are explicitly labelled.

tools.name: get_set_offers
tools.description: Find monitored retailer offers for one set in a supported market. Compare item prices and reported shipping totals. Unknown shipping is not free shipping. Results do not guarantee stock or checkout prices.

tools.name: compare_sets
tools.description: Compare specifications, retirement status and monitored offers for two to four distinct set numbers in the same retailer market.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Only for explicit collector, resale or sealed-set market-valuation requests. For price history, price development, Preisentwicklung or past shop prices, call get_retail_price_history first. Never use this tool as a fallback for partial or unavailable retailer history. Values are EUR collector valuat

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Find catalogue theme IDs and names, optionally by text. Theme IDs can be used to narrow a set search.

tools.name: get_retail_price_history
tools.description: First choice for price history, price trends, Preisentwicklung and past merchant prices. Read recorded delivered retailer prices in the selected market and currency. Use days 365 for the last 12 months. Partial coverage is valid history: show available observations and actual dates instead of saying

tools.name: assess_deal
tools.description: Compare the freshest known delivered offer with the recorded retail low and show coverage. No all-time-low claims or predictions. History excludes Amazon; current offers can include Amazon.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Find curated related sets, optionally cheaper by delivered price or with fewer pieces, and optionally within a delivered-price budget. Candidate coverage is bounded; fewer pieces does not establish physical dimensions.

tools.name: render_sets
tools.description: After searching or choosing sets, show the final one to six set IDs as shopping cards, or two to four as a side-by-side comparison. Includes images, reported delivered prices, card shortlist and app handoffs. Data remains available without UI.

tools.name: get_app_handoff
tools.description: Get the existing app link and steps for setting a price alert or saving a set to a Brickfact watchlist. This read-only handoff does not create anything. A target_price is an optional draft in the market currency; the user completes the action in the app.
